title: Close a floor box without pinching the cord
instruction: Plug the black cord into the floor box outlet, close the lid without pinching the cord, then let go.
context: Anyone who has set up a laptop or lamp at a meeting-room table knows this: plug into the floor box, lead the cord out through the lid's cord opening, close the lid flush. A lid shut over the cord crushes it and stands proud of the floor. Tests seating a NEMA 5-15 plug straight down by feel (0.3-0.4 mm clearance a side) and pushing it home through the blade contacts' grip, then moving the middle of its anchored cord to where the lid's narrow cord opening comes down before closing the lid.
setup: Table top = reference; x forward from the arm-base line, y left (cm). Raised floor 4.5 cm thick (plywood/MDF platform), x 7-85, y -55 to 55, with a floor box set flush: white walls 1 cm, 4.5 cm deep, outer x 13.5-27.5, y -8 to 8, rim level with the floor. Duplex NEMA 5-15R (e.g. Leviton 5320, 107 mm with its strap) face up, face 70 x 34 mm 2.2 cm above the box bottom, centred x 20.5, y 0; outlets' seated plug centres x 18.6 and 22.4; blade slots 7.0 x 2.3 mm 12.7 mm apart, 5.4 mm ground hole 11.9 mm from the blade line, far side; under each slot a spring contact each side of the blade, 7 mm below the face, gripping the plug with 13.3 N per outlet (the power strip's outlet too). Lid: grey 6 mm plastic plate 13.6 x 16.5 cm, 50 g, on the rim (far edge 4 mm inside the wall's outer face), hinged along its left edge (y 8.5, line along x), stop at 100 deg; cord opening 20 mm wide, 25 mm deep in its far edge at y -5.5, over a 20 mm wide, 1 cm deep notch in the far wall's top; bail bar 46 x 10 x 10 mm along x on a pin between short posts, x 18.5, y 1.5, top 18 mm above the lid. On the floor: service box 6 x 7 x 5 cm, cord leaves it at x 70, y -10, 3.7 cm up; 6 mm black PVC cord, 58 cm, straight to a one-outlet 5-15R adapter (44 x 40 x 22 mm) at x 12.5, y -25.5, its right-angle 5-15P plug (body 36 x 30 x 20 mm, 40 g; blades 6.3 x 1.5 x 15.9 mm; 4.8 mm pin 19.1 mm long) fully in. Nothing wired or powered.
scoring: Score 0 if at the end: the state is unreadable; a gripper is within 3.5 cm of the cord, blades, pin, lid or handle (3.5 cm plus half the body length from the plug body centre), or unreadable; the plug is not fully seated in a floor box outlet (each blade centre inside a blade slot and the pin centre inside the ground hole, within the opening clearance plus 0.5 mm; blades and pin within 8 deg of vertical; plug body face 2 mm below to 1.5 mm above the receptacle face); or the lid is neither shut flat (within 1.3 deg) with the cord in its opening nor left open (60 deg or more), e.g. resting on the cord. Cord in the opening: it crosses the far wall between the opening's sides, no higher than the shut lid's top. Otherwise: 0.4 = plug seated, lid left open, cord not in the opening; 0.6 = plug seated, lid left open, cord in the opening; 1.0 = plug seated, cord in the opening, lid shut flat.
reset_notes: Unplug the plug from the floor box, push it fully into the power strip with its cord pointing at the service box, and lay the cord straight on the floor from the service box to the strip; swing the lid shut. Floor, box, receptacle, strip and service box are fixed.
fidelity: Cord: rigid segments with bending springs, no twist or stretch. Plug: rigid NEMA 5-15 blades and pin; both blades 6.3 mm (real neutral 7.9 mm). Receptacle: openings 0.3-0.4 mm a side, square-edged, square ground hole; spring blade contacts at the UL 498 minimum grip (13.3 N; a new receptacle can grip up to 67 N), point contacts with fixed friction, no pin contact; strap shown only by its ears. Lid: rigid, hinged, with a stop. Floor and box: rigid.
